journal_entries.description: January 1, Year 1 - initial recognition of purchased license
December 31, Year 5 - amortization under the revised estimate
January 1, Year 7 - sale of license for cash

notes: Years 1-4 amortize 150,000/10 = 15,000 per year, so the January 1, Year 5 carrying amount is 90,000. The estimate change is prospective: 90,000 over the 4 remaining years = 22,500 per year for Years 5-8. After Year-6 amortization the carrying amount is 45,000, so the 40,000 sale on January 1, Year 7 produces a 5,000 loss. Total amortization Years 1-6 = 105,000, which ties to cost 150,000 less the 45,000 carrying amount removed. License is credited directly, so no accumulated amortization account appears in any entry.
